description: Edit repos/metric-collector-vessel/src/config.ts: change the in-code PORT default from 8280 to 8300. The current line is `export const PORT = parseInt(process.env["PORT"] ?? "8280", 10);` and the default "8280" collides with light-dispatch-vessel's default of 8280. The metric-collector unit file already sets PORT=8300, so changing the in-code default to 8300 makes the unit override redundant rather than load-bearing. Change only the "8280" string literal to "8300" on that one line.
